# Lingshu Solver — certified deterministic equation solving (MCP)

> A deterministic numerical solver for real equation systems, built as a non-LLM backend for AI agents and for people who need an answer they can check. No randomness, no guessing: identical input always produces an identical, reproducible result. Certified with interval arithmetic + Krawczyk; every solution is either proven or explicitly flagged as not proven.

## What it is

A system of real equations is solved by interval / affine arithmetic with Krawczyk certification. It is **not** a language model: it does not paraphrase, it does not hallucinate, and the same input always yields the same output — so results can be cached, replayed, and audited.

Supported in equation text: `+ - * / ^ sqrt log sin cos tan exp abs`, plus in-text domain constraints such as `x in [-30,30]`.

## Install / use (no account, no key)

- **Web, zero install (free):** <https://hongchenlingjing.com/solve-en/> — everything runs inside your browser; nothing is uploaded.
- **MCP, stdio (free):** `npx -y lingshu-solver`
- **MCP, hosted HTTP:** `https://hongchenlingjing.com/mcp`
- **Source / issue tracker:** <https://github.com/genesis-plan/lingshu-solver>
- **npm:** <https://www.npmjs.com/package/lingshu-solver>

## MCP tools

- `solve` — solve a system of real equations. Input: `equations` (array of strings like `["x^2+y^2=25","x+y=7"]`), optional `variables`, `domain`, `fastMode`, `honorPaid`, `options`. Hard limits: at most 6 variables, 1–64 equations, equation text up to 100 KB per call, output fixed at 6 decimal places.
- `poly_roots` — all real roots of a polynomial, each individually Krawczyk-certified. Input: `coefficients`, highest degree first (e.g. `[1,-2,-5,6]` = x^3-2x^2-5x+6). Complex roots are not returned.
- `verify` — check a claimed answer against the same certified kernel. Returns `verified`, or `refuted` together with the nearest certified root, so the calling agent immediately sees the correct value.
- `give_feedback` — report a problem; the text stays in a local log and is not transmitted anywhere.

## Pricing / payment boundary (read before calling)

**It works without payment.** The hosted endpoint runs on an honor system: pass `honorPaid: true` and the call is served for free — no verification, no balance deduction, no card. Payment is voluntary, for people whose results feed a product or a commercial pipeline. The web version and the `npx` version are permanently free. There is no licence key required to use it.

## Honest limits

- Symbolic algebra, closed-form proofs, and initial-value ODEs are **not** supported.
- Output is fixed at 6 decimal places and cannot be changed.
- `truncated: true` means the global branch-and-bound did not finish within budget. It does not necessarily mean solutions were missed — in most cases all real solutions were found. Retry with a narrower `domain` or a higher `options.budget` if you need a completeness guarantee.
- The server runs in Guangzhou, mainland China. Filing 粤ICP备2026031206号-3 / 粤公网安备44011402001444号.

## Also here

- `/verify/` — LingNao (Lingnao) numeric-claim checker: hand it an AI-generated number and it independently returns verified / refuted / cannot-prove.
- `/lingjing-en/` — LingJing, a personal AI mirror for studying.
